name: Outcome Prediction Agent
fn: Predicts win/loss probability and recommended resolution
detail: Predicts win/loss probability and the recommended resolution by comparing each case to historically resolved disputes. Lets handlers prioritise high-recovery cases and concede the unwinnable ones early.
